raw_text: Tatmadaw airstrikes in Chin State reaching dangerously close to Indian territory. Strikes reported within 5km of Mizoram border. Indian Army on alert. This highlights the growing instability along India's eastern border with Myanmar. The junta's willingness to bomb so close to an international border is a serious escalation.
